conditions.name: media_progress_stuck
conditions.guidance: Start at 15 minutes and compare with RUNNING_STATE_STALE.

conditions.name: queue_saturation
conditions.healthy: depth remains below the deployment capacity
conditions.recovery: depth remains below capacity for 10 minutes
conditions.guidance: Set capacity per normalized queue after measuring ordinary peaks.

conditions.name: media_terminal_failure
conditions.unknown: execution signals exist but domain outcomes are absent
conditions.recovery: a later operation succeeds and no new failure occurs
conditions.guidance: Start with any encryption failure and a five-minute window for other stages.

conditions.name: hls_encryption_invalid
conditions.unknown: HLS work has no terminal outcome
conditions.recovery: a validated encrypted HLS operation succeeds
conditions.guidance: Fire on the first invalid encryption outcome.

conditions.name: email_terminal_failure
conditions.healthy: terminal outcomes are smtp_accepted or skipped
conditions.unknown: queued receipts have no later state
conditions.recovery: the failure rate returns below the deployment threshold
conditions.guidance: Fire immediately for authentication_error and after three failures for transient classes.

conditions.name: email_sending_stale
conditions.healthy: no receipt is reclassified as unknown
conditions.degraded: outcome unknown with reason worker_lost occurs
conditions.recovery: recovery runs and no new unknown receipt appears
conditions.guidance: Fire on the first worker_lost result.

conditions.name: scheduled_job_stale
conditions.healthy: last success is inside the registry absence window
conditions.degraded: last success is older than the absence window
conditions.unknown: last-started and last-success signals are absent
conditions.recovery: a new successful run updates last success

conditions.name: beat_stale
conditions.degraded: freshness is older than three minutes
conditions.recovery: beat emits a new freshness timestamp

conditions.name: worker_health
conditions.healthy: each expected worker heartbeat is recent
conditions.degraded: a heartbeat is older than two minutes
conditions.unknown: the expected worker inventory is unavailable
conditions.recovery: the worker emits a new heartbeat

conditions.name: http_failures
conditions.healthy: the 5xx rate is below one percent
conditions.degraded: the 5xx rate exceeds one percent for five minutes
conditions.unknown: request traffic exists outside telemetry but metrics are absent
conditions.recovery: the 5xx rate remains below one percent for ten minutes
conditions.guidance: Start at one percent with a minimum request count.

conditions.name: http_latency
conditions.healthy: p95 is below the endpoint objective
conditions.degraded: p95 exceeds the objective for ten minutes
conditions.unknown: request counters increase but latency samples are absent
conditions.recovery: p95 remains below the objective for ten minutes

conditions.name: telemetry_loss
conditions.healthy: the application target and collector export path report success
conditions.degraded: export failures persist for five minutes
conditions.unknown: both application and collector signals are absent
conditions.recovery: scrapes and exports succeed for ten minutes
conditions.guidance: Keep this alert outside user request and task failure paths.
